title.narrative: A CONTRIBUTION TO SUPPORT YESH DIN’S 2023 WORK PLAN AND BUDGET FOR THEIR ACTIVITIES IN THE OCCUPIED PALESTINIAN TERRITORY FOR THE PERIOD FROM 1 JANUAR

description.narrative: Yesh Din is an Israeli NGO which focuses on four key programmes: law enforcement in relation to settler violence, due process for Palestinians before Israeli military courts, law enforcement in relation to security personnel in their treatment of Palestinians, and a project called LANDS, focused on settlement development and Palestinian land issues. Yesh Din’s mission is to achieve long-term structural improvement in the human rights situation in the West Bank by monitoring the systematic violation of human rights in the West Bank, by documenting and disseminating accurate and up-to-date information regarding such violations, and by applying public and legal pressure on the Israeli government to end them.
